data.name: Sanika
data.long_meaning: Sanika is a Sanskrit name derived from the Sanskrit word 'sanikah' which means 'Goddess of prosperity'. In Hindu mythology, Sanika is an aspect of the Goddess Lakshmi, the goddess of wealth and prosperity. She is often depicted carrying a lotus in one hand and a golden lotus in another, symbolizing the abundance of material and spiritual wealth.
